0022600039.text: The Houston Rockets (8-3, 5th in the West) host the Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the West) in their 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are out for Houston, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 140-106 regular-season win in Houston on April 3, 2026.
